cards.intuition: The model paints a sparse weight vector over the whole vocabulary, lighting up related terms the text never used. That is expansion and weighting in one pass.
cards.formula: sparse vector over vocab, weights from MLM head, max-pooled and sparsified
cards.topic: SPLADE: Learned Term Expansion and Impact Weights

cards.intuition: BM25 gives a term one corpus-wide importance; SPLADE reads the surrounding text and prices the term in context, so `jaguar` differs between car and animal pages.
cards.formula: weight(term, doc) = f(context), not fixed IDF
cards.topic: SPLADE: Learned Term Expansion and Impact Weights

cards.intuition: Every activated term is a postings list the query must walk, so the training regularizer is really a dial between quality and serving latency.
cards.formula: more active terms -> bigger index, slower queries
cards.topic: SPLADE: Learned Term Expansion and Impact Weights

cards.intuition: Ask a model what questions this document could answer, staple those questions to the document, and let plain BM25 do the rest.
cards.formula: doc' = doc + generated queries, scored by BM25

cards.intuition: Generated queries add the words real searchers type, and repeating the salient concepts inflates their term frequencies, which BM25 reads as importance.
Appended queries are baked into the index at generation time, so a better generator helps only after a full re-expansion pass over the corpus.
Postings store quantized learned weights instead of tf, sorted by weight so the scorer can stop early once nothing left can crack the top k.
cards.formula: (docID, quantized weight), sorted by weight desc
cards.topic: Impact-Sorted Indexes: Neural Weights on the Classic Inverted Index

cards.intuition: A learned weight depends on the document and the checkpoint, not on corpus-wide IDF, so adding documents no longer shifts every score under your feet.
cards.formula: weight = g(doc, model), independent of corpus stats
cards.topic: Impact-Sorted Indexes: Neural Weights on the Classic Inverted Index

cards.intuition: Every stored weight came from one encoder checkpoint, so upgrading the model invalidates the whole index and forces a full rebuild.
cards.formula: new encoder -> re-encode corpus -> rebuild index
cards.topic: Impact-Sorted Indexes: Neural Weights on the Classic Inverted Index

cards.intuition: ELSER and OpenSearch neural sparse run the same play: inference at ingest writes weighted tokens into the engine that already serves BM25.
cards.formula: encode at ingest -> rank_features field -> sparse dot product
cards.topic: Shipped Learned Sparse: ELSER and Neural Sparse Search

cards.intuition: Run the heavy encoder on documents at ingest and a light path on queries, so search latency stays low while documents get full expansion.
cards.formula: heavy doc encoder + light query path
cards.topic: Shipped Learned Sparse: ELSER and Neural Sparse Search

cards.intuition: Learned sparse wins on a Lucene stack with mixed exact and paraphrase traffic and CPU serving; dense wins multilingual, multimodal, and very short text.
cards.formula: one engine and one ACL model vs second vector system
cards.topic: Shipped Learned Sparse: ELSER and Neural Sparse Search
